notes: James A. Dixon, page-face office 'Ut. County Commission Seat A', party 'Republican'; index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the PAGE FACE governs and the coordinator may promote the name through office_overrides.csv (the Ainge precedent). The page face DOES print the seat ('Seat A'), matching what index.csv already carries - no seat was inferred. 5 pages, legacy_colAB: p1 cover ('30 Days after withdraw or elimination' ticked, amendment ticked 'No', signed May 14 2018), p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 SCHEDULE A ('Page 1 of 1'), pp4-5 SCHEDULE B ('Page 1 of 2', 'Page 2 of 2'). *** A FAX PAGE COUNTER PROVES THE DOCUMENT IS COMPLETE. *** Every sheet carries the sending machine's header '05/16/2018 12:40 01' with 'PAGE 01/05' through 'PAGE 05/05'. ADDENDUM D6 records the fax counter as admissible `no-schedule-page` evidence when sheets are MISSING; this is the converse and is just as useful - the counter says all five transmitted sheets are present, so neither side's absence question arises and the filing is complete as filed. It also dates the transmission two days after the candidate signed. *** GENUINELY 2018-DATED STOCK, IN TWO MORE WORDINGS. *** The inner sheets are strap-lined '2018 County Candidate' (p2, p4, p5) and '2018 County Candidates' (p3) - the filing mixes singular and plural within itself. Together with Grunander's '2018 County & Local School Candidates', Hemingway's '2018 County Candidate(s)' and Phelps's '2018 County & Local School Candidates', this chunk establishes beyond doubt that genuinely 2018-dated inner sheets circulate, which ADDENDUM G5 left open - and that at least THREE 2018 straplines were in use, alongside the leftover 2016 stock that Thompson and Sakievich filed on. The cover here is the county-only blank ('FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5) with the vertical sidebar 'COUNTY COMMISSION CANDIDATES' - the same Commission-sidebar cover Hemingway used for a CLERK/AUDITOR filing, confirming the sidebar is decorative stock and not an office claim. SCHEDULE B COLUMN VOCABULARY: 'Provider/Vendor', with NO Purpose column and no purpose written anywhere, so `purpose` is honestly blank on all 29 expenditure rows. DITTO MARKS: the filer uses them freely in the address column and ONCE in the vendor column (p4 row 16, repeating 'Pioneer Party & Copy'); the repeated value is carried and the notation named in each row's note. INTRA-DOCUMENT DATE DISCREPANCY: the cover is signed 'May 14, 2018' while the Date of Report box on all four following sheets reads '5/1/18', and the fax header is dated 05/16/2018. All three recorded, none adjudicated. NIL MARKS: summary lines 3 and 7 are SLASHED ZEROS and read 0 under the zero-glyph ruling. PRIVACY: the county did NOT redact this filing; street lines are visible on Schedule A and on both Schedule B sheets and the cover prints the candidate's home address and phone. None is carried - contributions reduce to city/state at read time and expenditure rows carry no address field at all. FEE-TABLE OBSERVATION (never used to settle a figure): this filing's 2018 Utah County COMMISSION filing fee is 647.22, which is ADDENDUM G6's recorded 2016 and 2018 Commission figure. It also explains the 648.22 on Thomas Sakievich's 2018 Commission filing in this same chunk, which he labels 'Register Run + Ck fee' and pairs with a separate 1.00 cashier's-check fee: 647.22 + 1.00. That is an observation about two documents in the same office and cycle, in the sense ADDENDUM F5 allows, and nothing on either filing was settled by it.
